# The 20-Watt Computer (Компьютер на 20 ваттах)

> A free textbook by Konstantin Kladko on how the brain computes, written for engineers: the brain treated as a machine, in terms of circuits, signals, codes, control loops, learning rules and energy budgets. Neurons are typed by what they put on the wire: ГЛУТ (glutamate) is the data bus, ГАМК (GABA) is flow control, and ДОФА (dopamine), СЕРО (serotonin), НОРА (noradrenaline) and АЦЕТ (acetylcholine) are broadcast control registers. Every number comes from a runnable Python model, and every major claim is traced to its experiment in an experimental supplement. The text is in Russian; an English edition is in progress. License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (text), MIT (code).

Each chapter page has a short version (no formulas, with drawings) and a full version (formulas, models, exercises with answers).

## Chapters

- [How to read this book](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/00.html): chapter map and reading paths
- [1 Neuron types](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/01.html): one neuron, one output transmitter; the receiver's receptor sets the sign
- [2 What ГЛУТ neurons compute](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/02.html): excitatory-only networks compute monotone functions; dual-rail asynchronous logic
- [3 ГЛУТ and ГАМК together](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/03.html): with inhibition any Boolean function; winner-take-all; E/I stability
- [4 Morse code: the language of neurons](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/04.html): spike-channel capacity, noise, rate vs timing codes, the energy limit
- [5 What СЕРО neurons compute](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/05.html): logic through volume transmission; independent chemical wires
- [6 Networks that learn: adding ДОФА](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/06.html): Hebb and Oja, the three-factor rule, gradient descent without backward wires
- [7 Alternative theories of dopamine learning](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/07.html): distributional coding, two signals on one wire
- [8 When to search and when to decide: НОРА](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/08.html): gain control, exploration, the inverted U
- [9 When to write and when to read: АЦЕТ](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/09.html): write/read modes, acetylcholine as a Kalman gain
- [10 The whole machine](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/10.html): the three-layer architecture
- [11 Inputs: eyes, ears and other sensors](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/11.html): transducers at physical limits, automatic gain control
- [12 Image and video recognition](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/12.html): the AND/OR selectivity-invariance pipeline, illusions
- [13 Outputs: how the brain controls muscles](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/13.html): a hierarchy of controllers
- [14 Pain: the alarm signal](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/14.html): two wires and a gate
- [15 How the machine learns to move](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/15.html): three teachers, the error wire, fast and slow learners
- [16 The second output: body chemistry](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/16.html): hormone cascades, precision vs stability (K < 8)
- [17 Debugging the machine](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/17.html): probes, brain–computer interfaces, low-dimensional activity
- [18 Neuron types by electrical function](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/18.html): neurons as integrators, filters, oscillators, dividers
- [19 Neurons by number of dendrites](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/19.html): fan-in follows the task
- [20 What neurons do during sleep](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/20.html): sleep as a set of modes, a relay with hysteresis
- [21 Machines made of living neurons](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/21.html): cultures on electrode arrays, reservoirs, dopamine in a dish
- [22 DishBrain](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/22.html): the scrambler teacher, a reproducible specification of the rig

## Reference

- [Experimental supplement](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/d.html): the source experiment for every major claim
- [Answers to exercises](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/c.html)
- [Notation](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/b.html)
- [References](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/read/refs.html)
- [Full book, PDF](https://kladkogex.github.io/20-watt-computer/pdf/20-watt-computer-ru.pdf)
